<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md before opening a PR. Solve one underlying problem.
Use a conventional commit title in plain language, such as "fix(browser): keep the selection after a rename".
-->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem in a sentence or two. Include the expected behavior and
reproduction steps where relevant. -->

## Change

<!-- Explain how this fixes the problem. If it spans crates, explain why the
changes belong to the same fix. Split independent fixes into separate PRs. -->

## Scope and approval

<!-- Link the issue where a maintainer agreed to the direction and scope. For a
small fix of an obvious bug, explain why it needs no prior issue. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe the focused tests or manual checks you ran and what you observed.
State anything you could not check. "Tests pass" alone is not enough.

For UI changes, include before and after images. For motion, include a short
video. Upload evidence to GitHub and embed or link it here. Never commit it. -->

<!-- If you used an agent, end with the model and harness that did the work. -->
